title: Ron's visits to the spirit world with Elby; the crystal table

tellings.quote: here? Anyway, Elby takes him to the spirit world three times.

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, relays a story from a man he calls Ron, linked to Utah. Cameron says a being or guide named Elby took Ron to the spirit world three times, and the story involves a crystal table there. If true, it would suggest contact with something that can lead a living person into a realm beyond death.
